title: SK hynix's Solidigm Weighs U.S. IPO at Up to $150 Billion: What It Is and Who Owns It
content:
Korea Supply Chain Brief · September 27, 2026

Solidigm, the enterprise SSD maker owned by SK hynix (KRX: 000660), is weighing a U.S. IPO as early as next year, Reuters reported citing people familiar with the matter. If it happens at the reported valuation, it would be one of the largest chip IPOs ever. Here is what Solidigm is, how SK hynix owns it, and what has and has not been confirmed.

CompanyRoleEvidence
Solidigm
(unlisted, U.S.)		Enterprise SSD and NAND flash maker; the company reportedly considering the IPOReported (Reuters, citing sources; relayed by Yonhap, Sep 26, 2026)
SK hynix
KRX: 000660		Ultimate parent. Solidigm sits under "AI Company," SK hynix's U.S. investment subsidiaryReported (Yonhap)

What was reported

  • Solidigm held a "bake-off" this week, meetings where investment banks pitch to lead an IPO.
  • A listing could come as early as next year. Size and timing are at an early stage and could change.
  • Sources told Reuters the company could be valued at up to US$150 billion (about KRW 204 trillion) and could raise about US$15 billion.
  • For scale, Arm Holdings was valued at US$54 billion in its 2023 IPO, and Cerebras had a market value of US$56.4 billion at its IPO price in May 2026.

SK hynix and Solidigm have not confirmed the plan in the reports we reviewed.

How SK hynix owns Solidigm

YearStep
2021SK hynix buys Intel's NAND flash and SSD business and sets it up as a U.S. company, Solidigm
Early 2026Solidigm becomes a subsidiary of AI Company, a U.S. investment arm SK hynix set up
NowSK hynix → AI Company → Solidigm (Solidigm is SK hynix's "grandchild" company)

What Solidigm makes, and why the valuation jumped

Solidigm sells enterprise SSDs, the high-capacity flash storage used in servers, cloud infrastructure and data centers. AI training and inference need to store and move huge data sets, and demand for high-capacity NAND flash has risen with the AI build-out. Yonhap noted that Solidigm is also reported to be considering a NAND flash production site in New York State.

Most coverage of SK hynix focuses on HBM, the stacked DRAM that sits next to AI chips. Solidigm is the other half of its AI exposure: storage rather than memory.

Questions to watch

  • How much of Solidigm would be sold, and how much SK hynix would keep.
  • Whether proceeds would fund the reported New York NAND plant.
  • How an IPO price would compare with SK hynix's own valuation.

None of these were answered in the reports so far.

Quick FAQ

Is Solidigm owned by SK hynix?
Yes. It was formed in 2021 from Intel's NAND and SSD business that SK hynix acquired, and it now sits under SK hynix's U.S. subsidiary AI Company.

When is the Solidigm IPO?
Reuters reported it could come as early as next year. The timing and size are not final and could change.

How much is Solidigm worth?
Sources cited by Reuters said up to US$150 billion. That is a reported estimate, not an IPO price.
